items.t: Air suspension springs leak and the car sags
items.note: RepairPal's average for one Phaeton air strut is over $2,100. Many owners replace them in pairs.

items.job: Replace air suspension compressor and relay
items.note: Aftermarket compressors start near $150; a genuine VW unit is about $1,100.

items.t: Engine overheating from cooling system failures
items.note: RepairPal lists Phaeton water pump replacement at $1,012-$1,322 and thermostat at $560-$750. A new radiator adds more.

items.job: Repair or replace trunk lid wiring harness
items.note: One owner paid $450. A full new loom costs over $500 in parts.

items.job: Replace battery and test for parasitic drain
items.note: RepairPal lists Phaeton battery replacement at $450-$513. Finding a drain takes extra diagnostic time.

items.t: Water damage to keyless entry module from clogged sunroof drains
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and replace keyless entry (KESSY) module
items.note: Repairs can top $1,000 (about £1,000 in the UK). Clearing drains alone is cheap.

items.t: Power steering lines rust and leak
items.note: YourMechanic quoted about $1,210 for the same job on the related Touareg. Splicing in a section costs less.
National average for this job is about $700; Phaeton parts sit at the high end.
RepairPal lists $935-$1,040 for a Phaeton window regulator motor.
RepairPal lists Phaeton ignition coil replacement at $719-$948.
Torque converter or internal repairs cost far more.
Specialists remove the intake manifold; a dealer may quote much more.

items.t: Suspension control arm bushings wear and knock
items.note: Aftermarket front arm pairs run about $77-$240 each set; replacing all front arms costs more. Get an alignment afterward.

items.t: Climate control vents and flaps stop working
items.job: Diagnose and replace HVAC flap motor
items.note: Labor depends on which flap motor failed; some sit deep in the dash.
